problem:
Consider the following differential equation.

$$
9{x}^{2}{y}^{″}+12x{y}^{′}+(9x-2)y=0
$$

Which of the following is a Frobenius series solution to the differential equation, where ${a}_{n}$ for $n=0,1,2,…$ are constants determined by substitution?

*Hint: Substituting a trial Frobenius series solution into each term of the ODE, we obtain*

$$
\begin{aligned}9{x}^{2}{y}^{″} & =9({\lambda }^{2}-\lambda ){a}_{0}{x}^{\lambda }+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }9((\lambda +n)^{2}-(\lambda +n)){a}_{n}{x}^{\lambda +n}, \\ 12x{y}^{′} & =12\lambda {a}_{0}{x}^{\lambda }+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }12(\lambda +n){a}_{n}{x}^{\lambda +n}, \\ (9x-2)y & =-2{a}_{0}{x}^{\lambda }+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }(9{a}_{n-1}-2{a}_{n}){x}^{\lambda +n}.\end{aligned}
$$
